name: dc-basrahs_edge-coop-lod0-rec
description: dc-basrahs_edge-coop-rec with `aiSettings.lodEnable 0` (every bot at AI LOD 0, every shot real): the one DC level with a co-op layer that places static wrecks (six `DC_pickup-wreck1_m1`, a `DC_slumwreckage1_m1`), for whether retail rounds and bodies pass through a static that never writes `hasCollisionPhysics 1` (COL-16..18). Also whether retail bots move on its tank search map. Needs `lab.py setup --mods-from-client DesertCombat`.
human: No client needed: the server records itself. One round, then `lab.py stop`.
